name: Odine Solutions Teknoloji Ticaret ve Sanayi A.S.
summary: Odine Solutions Teknoloji Ticaret ve Sanayi A.S. operates as a technology partner in Turkey and internationally. The company offers strategic consulting and advisory; systems integration and managed services; AI-driven product development; and cloud transformation, artificial intelligence, automation, infrastructure, 5G, cybersecurity, enterprise solutions, and wholesale OSS/BSS services. It also engages in software product development, marketing, and distribution; software-based networks, virtualization, and cloud solutions; engineering, consulting, and technical support activities; telecommunications consulting services; telecommunications and communications network; development of patents…
